plugins.name: kcc-core
plugins.description: Core plugin: thinking & communication principles injected at session start, with a subagent variant injected into every spawned subagent.

plugins.name: kcc-dev-core
plugins.description: Development-focused plugin: conditionally injects code-discipline principles when the session is inside a software project (with a subagent variant injected into every spawned subagent), and hosts standalone dev skills (write-spec, write-acceptance-criteria) and hooks.

plugins.name: kcc-testing
plugins.description: LLM-executable manual QA test case authoring — write-test-cases skill turns a PRD into a YAML coverage set.
